4863-5744-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4863-5744-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Revolutionist token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

880-5478-8337.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-5478-8337.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the land enters the battlefield, M'Ress triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4089-4808-4812-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying {2}{U}, causing it to enter with additional Shapeshifter Rogue types as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

2226-2543-6751.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2543-6751.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Shivan Wurm by paying its mana cost.
When Shivan Wurm enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3330-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3330-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

628-2018-5284.description:
Activate Blood Vassal by sacrificing it.
When Blood Vassal dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Blood Vassal from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Blood Vassal by sacrificing it.
When Blood Vassal dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Blood Vassal from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat

728-1303-1769.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Rot Hulk enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Rot Hulk.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, failing to return anything to the battlefield.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token Rot Hulk enters, it triggers, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

394-3240-3899-6462.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2167-5626-5721-7893.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}.
You control at least six mana-producing lands, one of which can tap to produce at least {B} and another of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
2167-5626-5721-7893.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers that many times, creating that many creature tokens.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

4017-5641-6890-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-5641-6890-7810.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat from step 2.

849-1263-2921-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

670-1619-5887-6142.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-5887-6142.description:
Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Eccentric Apprentice until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, causing Eccentric Apprentice to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Eccentric Apprentice enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Eccentric Apprentice trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Werefox Bodyguard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Eccentric Apprentice until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4184-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
4184-5256-6972.notes: If Relentless Skaabs starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

628-2921-7194.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Burdened Stoneback.
When Burdened Stoneback dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

1409-5423-6751.description:
Activate Swashbuckler Extraordinaire by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Swashbuckler Extraordinaire enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Swashbuckler Extraordinaire.
Resolve both Swashbuckler Extraordinaire triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1495-3334-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Lae'zel.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

4775-6553-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2558-5687-5688-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Judith, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

2732-5256-6132.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

11-1235-4503-5195.description:
Cast Sea Gate Stormcaller by paying {1}{U}.
When Sea Gate Stormcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn with mana value 2 or less.
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, targeting Sea Gate Stormcaller.
Sea Gate Stormcaller and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sea Gate Stormcaller trigger, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Sea Gate Stormcaller.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Sea Gate Stormcaller with haste.
When the token Sea Gate Stormcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn with mana value 2 or less.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Twinflame.
Sea Gate Stormcaller and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sea Gate Stormcaller trigger, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand and creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting Twinflame.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, returning Twinflame to your hand and creating a copy of Twinflame targeting Sea Gate Stormcaller.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Twinflame copy, creating a token copy of Sea Gate Stormcaller with haste.
When the token Sea Gate Stormcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn with mana value 2 or less.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

997-1445-4871-5631.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
997-1445-4871-5631.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4616-5686-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4616-5686-6249--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2713-4499-5422.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking The Third Doctor.
When The Third Doctor enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

511-817-3921-4050-4365.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2438-4871-5544-6011.notablePrerequisites: Scavenger's Talent is at least level 2.
2438-4871-5544-6011.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Scavenger's Talent's second ability triggers, targeting an opponent, and Pitiless Plunderer triggers.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Scavenger's Talent trigger, causing an opponent to mill two cards.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4050-4053-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least nine other nontoken creatures. This pre-requisite can be reduced if you control one or more nontoken Angels with toughness 2+, or if you have creature cards in your graveyard plus additional {W/B} mana and/or Blood tokens.
4050-4053-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another nontoken creature, creating at least one Blood artifact token.
Repeat step 1 until you control at least six Blood tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {W/B}.
Repeat step 3 until you have {W/B}{W/B}{W/B} available.
Activate Shilgengar by paying {W/B}{W/B}{W/B} and sacrificing six Blood tokens, returning all creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield without a finality counter on them due to Solemnity.
Repeat.
If you control additional nontoken creatures, you may sacrifice them in step 1 to get infinite Blood tokens, and/or in step 3 to get infinite colored mana.

requires.n: Artifact Creature with Mana Cost X and Toughness 0

218-1295-1368-2719--39.notablePrerequisites: Sakashima of a Thousand Faces is a copy of Diligent Excavator.
218-1295-1368-2719--39.description:
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying {0}.
Diligent Excavator and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
The artifact creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast the artifact creature from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard, except Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 until you have an empty library.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast Thassa's Oracle  from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

565-1444-2792.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{G}.
565-1444-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{G}.
Cast Elvish Fury with buyback by paying {4}{G}, targeting Great Whale.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve Elvish Fury, giving the nontoken Great Whale +2/+2 until end of turn and returning Elvish Fury to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{G}, this combo nets infinite mana, which you can then target any creatures you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.

3086-3175-3603-4605.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Lagrella.
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it and Preston triggers.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Sun Titan until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Lagrella that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Lagrella into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Lagrella is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Sun Titan is returned to the battlefield from exile.
Sun Titan, Lagrella and Preston each trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sun Titan that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sun Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, choosing to return nothing to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on the nontoken Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger from step 8, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1308-1480-3828.notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Squirrel Mob.
You control an extra creature.
413-1308-1480-3828.description:
Tap Blasting Station, sacrificing a creature to deal 1 damage to Squirrel Mob.
Create two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

2103-3554-4582.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
2103-3554-4582.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Beseech the Queen by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Beseech the Queen and Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

56-3391-4050.description:
Activate Korozda Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{B}{G} and sacrificing Hogaak.
If Hogaak is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Korozda Guildmage trigger, creating eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by tapping seven Saprolings.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Saprolings, adding {2}{B}{G}.
Repeat.
